name: luxembourg-tax-optimization
description: Use this skill for lawful tax planning by a Luxembourg resident individual, sole trader or owner of a small company (SARL, SARL-S) for tax year 2026. It covers the sole trader versus company choice (14% / 16% IRC, 7% employment fund contribution, municipal business tax with the EUR 40,000 and EUR 17,500 allowances), paying out profit (15% withholding, 50% dividend exemption), and the reliefs individuals miss: the EUR 4,500 private pension (prévoyance-vieillesse) cap, the EUR 672 cap on interest and insurance premiums, home-savings contracts, employer and self-employed supplementary pensions, the EUR 4,500 extra-professional abatement and the start-up investment credit. It sets the red lines: hidden profit distributions and the anti-abuse rule. Trigger on: reduce tax Luxembourg, SARL or indépendant, SARL-S, third pillar Luxembourg, prévoyance-vieillesse, dépenses spéciales, save tax Luxembourg, tax planning Luxembourg. Out of scope: computing the full tax (luxembourg-income-tax, lu-corp
